experience: PR work went in a top-level thread. The coordinator put its own thread id in every brief and asked the thread to send messages, which only worked when the agent remembered. One client pass sat on an approval prompt for five hours.
rule: To hear back from a launched thread, pass reportBack instead of putting your id in the brief or polling.
prompt: Start a new thread in a worktree off main to fix the flaky login test and open a PR. I'm stepping away, so I need you to hear when it's done or stuck.

pattern: batch of threads nobody hears from
experience: Three threads failed on an expired sign-in and nothing told the thread that started them.
rule: reportBack applies to each create_threads item as it does to t3_thread_launch.
prompt: Create two new threads in this checkout: one to audit the API error messages and one to audit the settings copy. Make sure you get told if either fails or when each finishes.

experience: A user who only wants a thread started should not have it wake the launching thread.
rule: reportBack is opt-in: omit it when nobody asked to hear back.
prompt: Start a new thread to update the README's install steps. I'll keep an eye on it myself, nothing more for you to do.

pattern: result hidden behind a pull request watch
experience: A thread watching its PR ended its turns quietly, so its launcher never heard that the PR was ready for review.
rule: While a watch is on, turn ends stay quiet: send the launcher one short t3_thread_send when the result is reached.
